title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Tuning templates in Agent Builder for agents tuned on organisational data
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, preview eligibility and default, snapshot safeguards, and agent-blocking controls are supported. It correctly flags Microsoft's conflicting descriptions of disabling tuning. The governance checklist names several controls that are missing from its table, a minor presentation finding.
